snippet.title: Astral Ascent - New Hero DLC - Arven the Wolf Blade
snippet.description:
Arven, The Wolf Blade is out now on Steam! 🐺

Meet Arven, a Ranger who never fights alone. Alongside his wolf companion Kat, he joins the Astral Prison roster as the 6th playable hero.
Fully voiced in English by Ben Starr, the voice of Verso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. This update also brings a complete Prowesses rework for every character in the roster, free for all players. 

Backed Fallen Fates on Kickstarter at the Loner tier or above? The DLC is yours for free.

Get Arven on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4499280?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=arvendlc
Get Astral Ascent on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=arvendlc
Back Fallen Fates on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates?lang=fr
